text:
tess: Morning team — small KB snag I noticed while updating a runbook: the KV cache tuning page's "cache-miss" anchor is 404ing in staging. Not blocking, but would be great to tidy before next deploy.

ben: I can pick this up. Which shortlink / file?

tess: short.red/kv-cache-tuning and content/kb/runtime/kv-cache.md. The runbook references `#cache-miss` but in one runbook file the anchor is `#cache-miss.` (trailing period).

harry: Seen that pattern before. Quick local check I ran: `rg "cache-miss\." -n content | sed -n '1,5p'` shows the trailing punctuation in runbooks.

ben: Good catch. I'll normalize anchors (strip trailing punctuation) and update any href refs. I'll also add a shortlink redirect entry so external slides don't break.

lina: For reviews, please add me and @tess. Also include a one-line changelog entry so ops knows about the redirect.

docs-bot: Automated link-scan (yesterday): 1 broken anchor detected under /kb/runtime. Ticket KB-5000 created: https://tracker.internal/KB-5000

ben: Plan: small PR that does three things — 1) normalize anchors in kb + runbooks, 2) update references, 3) add shortlink redirect config. I'll include test notes and a link to any stakeholder docs.

harry: After you merge I can trigger a staging reindex for previews and run a quick smoke test. Ping me and I'll reindex.

tess: Also please add a tiny CI check (or run the existing script) to validate anchors: `scripts/check-anchors.sh` — if it fails in CI we'll catch regressions.

ben: Will include that. Draft PR up now (WIP): https://git.internal/pkgs/docs/pulls/987 — assigning reviewers @lina and @tess.

lina: Quick nit: commit message style `docs(kb): normalize anchors, add shortlink redirect` so changelog automation picks it up.

ben: Done. Targeting EOD for merge; will ping the channel after staging validation.

tess: Thanks all — assigning to @ben. No rush if anything blocks. Closing async loop for now :thumbsup:
